title: Features in v1.0 | ContextMint
description: What ships in ContextMint v1.0 — Engine operator console, VS Code chat modes, image evidence, ARGUS visual audit, Context Lens, packs, quality map, and glass-box routing.

hero.title: What ships in v1.0
hero.leadMid2: — not generic chat. This page lists capabilities in the Engine desktop app and VS Code extension. PR verification, blast-radius product SKUs, and the standalone CLI remain on the

components.title: Two components
components.engineText: Tray-native operator console: server and Ollama lifecycle, models, multi-repo indexing status, quality scans, logs, and support bundle export. System, Light, or Dark theme.
components.extensionText: Where engineers work: repo-aware chat, screenshot vision, ARGUS visual audit, Context Lens, context packs, quality findings, assisted patch preview, and session history — connected to Engine on loopback by default.

gates.title: Human gates (evidence before action)
gates.lensText: Pre-send preview of retrieved chunks, relevance scores, routing choice, and governance notes. Approve or exclude evidence before the model runs. Optional trust gate can require explicit confirmation on early sends.
gates.patchText: Assisted actions propose unified diffs; you review and confirm before anything applies. Quality-map clone signals can block apply on high-severity findings when configured. No silent writes to your repo.

images.title: Image evidence & local vision
images.lead: Paste UI screenshots and ask what you see — without sending code to a cloud API by default. ContextMint normalizes images, previews them in Context Lens, and routes through a local Ollama vision model when one is installed.

packs.title: Context packs & conventions
packs.packsText: Per-repo manifest.yaml plus markdown knowledge. Activate with @pack:name in chat. Pack panel lists, builds, and auto-syncs when source files change (debounced).
packs.conventionsTextBefore: Conventions panel surfaces active rules, pending proposals, and audit history — human approval before conventions enter the graph. Complements the quality map and DNA vision on the

operator.title: Engine operator console
operator.lead: Engine is recovery and lifecycle control — not a daily dashboard. Tray-first; open the window when you need to diagnose.

quality.title: Quality map
quality.text: Stored governance findings from your repo — clone pairs, near-duplicates, and structure signals. Inform-only by default; optional gates can block assisted apply on high-severity clones. Run scans from the extension command palette or Engine → Quality.

optional.title: Optional & preview
optional.lead: BYOK cloud and Differentiator surfaces stay opt-in. Coding-day Parity defaults (agent, review, inline, live progress) are on after Wave J1 — Full Parity / one-seat claim still requires continuous dogfood (GATE-FULL-PARITY).

roadmapSection.title: On the roadmap
roadmapSection.text: Three tiers: what ships in v1.0, what design partners co-build in 2026, and the Verification Engine direction ahead — PR gates, blast radius, drift, and enterprise packaging.

installSection.title: Install
installSection.text: Engine installer + VS Code extension. First chat in minutes on the local-first path.

cta.title: Want a guided walkthrough?
cta.text: Apply as a design partner for a 30-day evaluation pilot (extendable to 90) with direct engineering support and a written summary for stakeholders. Intake opens by start of September 2026.
